item.title: Proposal Would Ban Certain Dyes, Preservatives From Indiana School Lunches
item.description: Indiana could join a growing number of states scrutinizing ultra-processed foods in schools under legislation heard Wednesday that would restrict certain additives in student meals and snacks.

item.title: Four Join Manchester University Board Of Trustees
item.description: Four new members, including three alumni, have joined Manchester University's board of trustees.

item.title: Steve Haab
item.description: Steve Haab, 84, formerly of Milford, died Thursday, Jan. 1, 2026, in Vero Beach, Fla. He was born on Aug. 8, 1941 and lived in Milford. He married Marceil Furrer; who survives. No funeral services are planned at this time.

item.title: DCS Releases Annual Report of Child Abuse, Neglect Fatalities In 2024
item.description: The Indiana Department of Child Services investigated 276 child deaths in 2024 and determined 59 were a result of abuse or neglect.

item.title: Indiana Candidate Filings Start Amid Republican Conflict, Democratic Optimism
item.description: The bruising Statehouse fight over Indiana congressional redistricting is looming over the formal start of the legislative campaign season.

item.title: Mariah Roberts Joins Indiana Watershed Leadership Academy

item.title: Young, GOP Rebukes Trump On Venezuela With War Powers Resolution
item.description: In a rare rebuke to President Donald Trump, Senate Republicans joined Democrats in advancing a war powers resolution to halt U.S. military action in Venezuela without congressional authorization.
